name: Nikola Petrović
bio:
Nikola's journey into motorsport began later in life after a career in construction, where he developed a keen eye for detail and a practical understanding of material properties. He always had a passion for racing, spending weekends at local rallies. Frustrated with the repetitive nature of his construction job, he enrolled in a composite materials course and quickly excelled. He is eager to apply his skills in a fast-paced motorsport environment. 

Though relatively new to the professional racing scene, Nikola possesses an unwavering commitment to learning and improvement. He embraces a collaborative approach, readily seeking advice from senior technicians and actively participating in team discussions. His ambition fuels his dedication to mastering composite techniques, ensuring each component meets the highest standards of performance and safety. He believes that understanding the broad implications of each part leads to higher quality work.

physical.description: Nikola is of average height with a sturdy build, suggesting his background in manual labor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations and ideas.
Has a habit of meticulously cleaning his workspace before starting any task.
Constantly asks 'what if' questions to explore potential improvements in composite designs.
